item.text: Only ~20 minutes of budget remain, so I'll spend it on one targeted source check rather than another long test run.

Budget is nearly exhausted, so this turn was one focused source check plus a report update rather than another long test run.

What I added:

- **`ZKDatabase.allowDiscontinuousProposals`** is `false` in production code — only `zookeeper.test.allowDiscontinuousProposals` (set by `ZxidRolloverTest`/`TxnLogDigestTest`) turns it on, so the ZOOKEEPER-4925 out-of-order committed-proposal guard is genuinely active in the shipped path. This was a plausible place for an injected "disable the safety check" change; it is intact.
- **`ObserverMaster`** proposal bookkeeping (`proposedPkts` → `committedPkts`): the `removeProposedPacket` consistency check, the amortized 5-packet eviction near 80 % of the size limit, and the hard cap are all as documented; no observer-side divergence path found.
- **Snapshot/roll thresholds and defaults vs `zookeeperAdmin.md`**: `SyncRequestProcessor.shouldSnapshot` (`logCount > snapCount/2 + randRoll`, `randRoll ∈ [0, snapCount/2)`), `tickTime=3000`, `globalOutstandingLimit=1000`, `maxClientCnxns=60`, `snapCount=100000`, `snapSizeLimitInKb=4 GiB`, `commitLogCount=500`, `snapshotSizeFactor=0.33`, `preAllocSize=64 M`, `fsync.warningthresholdms=1000`, `jute.maxbuffer=0xfffff`, session timeouts 2×/20× tick — all consistent.

These are recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md) §5 under the final pass, with the rest of the audit state unchanged: 239 test classes / 1763 tests executed and passing except the falsified flaky election test and the hostname/DNS environment blockers; no confirmed implementation defect yet.

If the audit continues, the remaining leads are the ones listed in §6: the handful of routines that cannot run here (`QuorumHammerTest`, `QuorumSSLTest`, the Kerberos/FIPS variants, the two FLE election tests), the untouched release-note checklist items (ZOOKEEPER-4872, 5049, 5082, 4886, 4954/4790, 2332, 2623, 4736, 4933), and deriving unit-level harnesses from the `zookeeper-specifications/` invariants (Agreement, TotalOrder, LocalPrimaryOrder, PrimaryIntegrity, PrefixConsistency) for the consensus paths that the suite does not assert directly.
